Sources Sought for
Energy Savings Performance Contracts

November 12, 2026

The Government is seeking to identify qualified sources under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220   Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, and Product Service Code (PSC) Z2DZ. The small business size standard is $45M.

This notice is for market research purposes only and is not a request for proposals (RFP) and does not constitute a solicitation nor does it restrict the Government as to the ultimate acquisition approach. This notice is open to all responsible sources regardless of business size or socioeconomic status. VA anticipates that offerors responding to any resulting solicitation will be required to be listed on the Department of Energy Federal Energy Management Program s Qualified Energy Service Company List (10 CFR 436.32) at the time of proposal submission and at the time of award. Firms not currently listed are encouraged to respond to this notice and to indicate whether they intend to apply for listing. Responses to this Sources Sought Notice will be used to determine whether this requirement can be set aside for certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs) or Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (VOSBs) under VAAR Subpart 819.70, or whether another approach is required including set-asides under the 8(a), HUBZone, or WOSB programs, or a small business set-aside.

The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs incurred in preparation of a response to this notice. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government does not intend to rank responses or provide any reply to interested businesses and responses will not be returned. Respondents should mark proprietary information. VA may share responses with Government support personnel, including DOE FEMP and national laboratory contractor staff bound by non-disclosure agreements, solely to support this market research.

1. CONTRACT INFORMATION: 

The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) intends to solicit and award multiple firm-fixed-price (FFP), indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity (IDIQ) contracts for Energy Savings Performance Contracting (ESPC) services under the authority of 42 U.S.C. Â§8287 and 10 CFR Part 436, using the negotiated procedures of FAR Part 15, as implemented by VA under the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) class deviations. Task orders will be competed among the IDIQ contract holders in accordance with fair opportunities procedures of FAR 16.505(b). Task orders issued under the resulting IDIQs will be firm-fixed-price. The VA anticipates awarding IDIQs with one 5-year base and one 5-year option period, totaling 10 years. The aggregate maximum value shared by all IDIQ contracts awarded is estimated at $1.5 billion ($750 million for the 5-year base ordering period and $750 million for the 5-year option ordering period), measured as the sum of all task order payment streams over the life of the awarded task orders. The full value of each task order counts against the ceiling for the ordering period in which it is issued. This figure is an estimate for market research purposes only and does not represent a guarantee of orders under any resulting contract.
The Government is gathering information to assist in determining an acquisition approach for this acquisition. As a result, the Government is performing market research in order to determine which businesses, small or other than small, possess the capability to execute the requirements within this Sources Sought Notice. 

2. PROJECT INFORMATION: 

VA is seeking information from interested contractors capable of developing, financing, implementing, and guaranteeing the performance of energy and water conservation measures at VA facilities under the authority of 42 U.S.C. Â§ 8287 and 10 CFR Part 436. Measures may include energy and water efficiency, energy and operational cost reduction, energy resilience and security for mission-critical healthcare operations, and on-site generation and distributed energy resources (including combined heat and power, geothermal, energy storage, microgrids, and renewable energy systems) where such measures are life-cycle cost-effective and fully funded from guaranteed savings. This acquisition supports VA s statutory energy and water management obligations under 42 U.S.C. Â§Â§ 8253 and 8287 and VA Directive 0055.

3. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS:

Interested contractors are requested to reply to this notice with a response to the Capability Questionnaire (Attachment 1). If no experience or capabilities are associated with a particular question, please indicate that within the questionnaire. 

Interested contractors should complete Sections 1   3 on Attachment 1 and provide narrative responses to the questions in Section 4. Submissions SHALL be received NO LATER THAN 2:00 PM Eastern Time, Wednesday, January 6, 2027; and should not exceed thirty (30) one-sided, 8.5  X 11  pages using no smaller than size 12 font. 
Graphics count toward the page limit. 
The surety letter requested in Attachment 1, Section 4, Question 4, is excluded from the page limit.
Any comments on the draft SOW are excluded from the page limit. 
The completed Attachment 1, Sections 1   3 is excluded from the page limit.
Do not exceed two pages per project when responding to Section 4 Question 9. 
All submissions and attachments must be compatible with Microsoft Office.
NO HARD COPY OR FACSIMILE SUBMISSIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED. 

Cover letters and extraneous materials (brochures, etc.) will not be considered.
